_: Turning points are editorial: a judgement that a moment mattered. Each one names the round it hangs on and an `assert` block the build checks against the ledger (score, result, goal minute, scorer) — a point whose evidence no longer matches the data fails the build rather than publishing a story the numbers do not support. Streaks and era splits are NOT authored; build/story.py counts them.

25-26.title: Amorim dismissed after MW20
25-26.body: Sacked on 5 January 2026, the day after a 1–1 at Leeds, on 1.55 points per game. Darren Fletcher took MW21 at Burnley; Michael Carrick was appointed on the 13th.

25-26.title: Carrick starts with the derby
25-26.body: First match in charge: City beaten 2–0 at Old Trafford, then Arsenal 3–2 away a week later — six points from the two sides that finished first and second.

25-26.title: 3–2 at the Emirates
25-26.body: Behind after 28 minutes, level by 36, ahead by 52, pegged back at 86 and won it at 89. The game-state walk for this match is on the 25/26 season page.

25-26.title: The dominance trap
25-26.body: Ten matches under 45% possession: ten wins, 3.00 points per game on an xG difference of +0.10. Fifteen matches over 55%: 1.40 per game on +1.07. The season's best chances came in its worst results.
25-26.source: 25/26 season payload, buckets split on ws_possession_pct

26-27.title: Opening day at a promoted side, lost 0–2
26-27.body: 71.7% of the ball, 21 shots, 1.81 xG to 1.59 — and nothing scored. The first match of the season set the dominance-trap pattern up again.

26-27.title: Five at home, a Fernandes hat-trick
26-27.body: Level at half time; four goals in twenty-six minutes after it. Bruno's three are three of the six attributed United goals so far.

26-27.title: Two points lost in the 96th minute
26-27.body: Šeško put United 2–1 up on 88; Maitland-Niles equalised on 96. United's xG was 0.86 to Everton's 1.42 — a draw the chances did not argue with.

26-27.title: Ugarte out until April
26-27.body: A cruciate ligament injury rules Manuel Ugarte out until early April 2027 — the season's one long-term absence so far.
